items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: I love what Matty did... I got involved with Matty Matlock heavily because I loved his book... I ended up buying most of his library from his son

ctx.x: Yeah. You led me to a question about being a band leader. And there’s a couple of things I want to ask you. First of all, what requirements, what do you require of a musician in order to hire them to be in your band.

Well I mean the band that I put together, which started pretty much as the Rosie O’Grady’s band, then the guy that owned the place sold it and you could see that it was kind of going, where in 1990 a bunch of us left there and we still had a couple of festivals that we’d been invited to, so we just kept that going and then — so I came up with this band. I really liked what Billy Maxted did, Matty Matlock and then Bob Crosby’s Bobcats that in other words they read music but they also played jazz you know. So I had…
She didn’t want to see music stands on the stage.
